name: GLaDOS
text: Your assistant has arrived, Gramps. Try not to lower the average intelligence on this side of the arena.

name: Darth Vader
text: Your machines have brought you far, Rick Gramps. They will not protect you here. Stand your ground. I will measure this power you claim to possess.

name: Goku
text: That was amazing! You really got me, Gramps. Sure, I will join your collection. Just promise we will keep finding stronger opponents. This is going to be fun!

name: Bill Cipher
text: OH, GRAMPS. YOU REACHED THE END OF REALITY AND FORGOT TO READ THE FINE PRINT! Pick up your little army. The final exhibit is still running the museum.
